adjudication.rationale: The finding is correct. Looking at the Office365CalendarService.ts diff (lines 70-76), the code extracts `[mainHostDestinationCalendar]` from `event.destinationCalendar ?? []`, which always takes the first element. Unlike GoogleCalendarService which was updated to accept a `credentialId` parameter and use `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` to select the correct calendar, Office365CalendarService was not updated with this pattern. This means for collective team events where multiple hosts have different destination calendars, Office365 will always create the event on the first host's calendar regardless of which credential is being used, which is incorrect behavior.
